title: Update Hosted API onboarding docs to match lifecycle email + console activation flow
author: Nikhil Sharma
description:
Context: Lifecycle growth experiments sprint is rolling out onboarding email v2 + in-console nudges. Our current Hosted API quickstart path doesn’t match the new CTAs (email + console) and we’re seeing confusion around “where do I create an API key?” and “what’s the fastest first request?”. This PR updates the onboarding docs so the docs, lifecycle emails, and console nudges all point to the same activation steps.

What changed: (1) Reworked Hosted API quickstart landing page to an explicit checklist: Create API key (Console) → Make first request (copy/paste snippet) → Enable streaming → View usage dashboard. (2) Added dedicated “First successful request” section with minimal curl + SDK examples aligned with the email CTA. (3) Updated internal links to console pages used by nudges (API keys, usage) so the docs match the console surface. (4) Added UTM-safe guidance for lifecycle CTAs (docs links do not hardcode campaign UTMs; emails can append UTMs). (5) Clarified common failure modes (“missing/invalid API key”, “403 due to org role”, “no tokens counted yet”) and point to the appropriate troubleshooting page.

Why: Reduce time-to-first-token (TTFT) and reduce early dropoff between signup → API key → first request. Also ensures messaging consistency with Soojin’s approved onboarding guidelines (latency/cost/reliability framing).

Notes/guardrails: No pricing language changes. No change to tracking pixels or retargeting tags. All outbound links remain first-party; lifecycle UTMs are appended by the email system.

Screenshots: N/A (docs-only).

Test plan: (a) Preview docs build locally, (b) validate all links (including /console deep links) and ensure no broken anchors, (c) run markdown lint.

Related: PM-659 (email onboarding v2 experiment design), PM-663 (console nudge experiment design). Also aligns with redwood-quickstarts PR-412 (Hello World activation snippet).
commits: docs(hosted-api): restructure quickstart into activation checklist
docs: add first-request snippets (curl + TS/Python) aligned with activation funnel
docs: update console deep links for api-keys + usage dashboard
docs: expand troubleshooting for missing/invalid API key and token accounting
chore: fix broken anchors and run markdown lint
conversation:
Soojin Lee (review): Can we tighten the value prop language to match the lifecycle messaging guidelines? Current intro says “cheapest inference” which we’ve been avoiding.

Nikhil Sharma (author): Good catch — updated the intro to “high-performance, reliable inference with clear cost controls” and removed “cheapest” wording. Also mirrored the email CTA phrasing: “Send your first request in < 2 minutes.”

Marissa Cole (review): The console deep link should land on the API Keys page inside the org context; can we avoid a generic /console link that dumps users on home?

Nikhil Sharma (author): Updated links to /console/settings/api-keys and /console/usage with a note that users may be prompted to select an org if they belong to multiple.

Dylan Brooks (review): Please avoid hardcoding UTMs in docs. Email tooling should add UTMs at send time; docs should remain canonical.

Nikhil Sharma (author): Agreed — removed UTMs from all links. Added a short note in the “Email CTA linking” callout that campaign params are appended by lifecycle tooling.

Tessa Morgan (review): The checklist headings are a bit dense on mobile. Can we shorten the step titles?

Nikhil Sharma (author): Shortened step labels and moved detail into collapsible callouts. Also adjusted code blocks to avoid horizontal scroll where possible.

Final reviewer notes: Link checker flagged one broken anchor in streaming.md; fixed and re-ran. All approvals received.

Approved-by: Soojin Lee; Marissa Cole; Dylan Brooks; Tessa Morgan.

Excerpt (quickstart.md):

## Get to first value (checklist)
1. Create an API key in the Console.
2. Send your first request (copy/paste).
3. (Optional) Enable streaming for lower perceived latency.
4. View tokens, latency, and errors in the usage dashboard.

### 1) Create an API key
Go to Console → Settings → API keys.

### 2) Send your first request
curl https://api.redwoodinference.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/verified-llama","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello"}]}'
release_notes: Docs-only: Hosted API onboarding flow updated to match lifecycle email v2 + console nudge CTAs (API key creation, first request snippet, streaming, usage dashboard).
